pages.title: My HRV is Very Low. Can I Increase My Heart Rate Variability? (Polar)
pages.reason: Highest-ranking external page whose job is the reader task (my HRV is low, how do I raise it): position 6 for 'how to improve hrv' and position 2 for the co-primary 'how to increase hrv'; cited by the AI Overview on both queries. Wearable-vendor guide with six improvement levers, each tied to a linked study.

pages.title: How to Improve Heart Rate Variability: 9 Things to Consider (UCF Health)
pages.reason: Second-highest dedicated how-to-improve page: position 7 for 'how to improve hrv' and 9 for 'how to increase hrv'; cited by the AI Overview on both. Academic medical practice page (2023) covering factors, box breathing, sleep, activity, nutrition and baseline measurement; no references.

pages.title: How to Increase HRV: 5 Proven Ways to Improve It (Different Health)
pages.reason: Third-highest dedicated page: position 9 for 'how to improve hrv' and 6 for 'how to increase hrv'; cited by the AI Overview on both. The only page that already ranks levers by strength of evidence and gives a tracking method, so it is the closest competitor to the intake angle.
